evidence.title: GitHub - radix-ui/primitives: Radix Primitives is an open-source UI component library for building high-quality, accessible design systems and web apps. Maintained by @workos. · GitHub

name: Radix Primitives
summary: Unstyled, accessible React UI primitives — around 30 components plus utilities — for building design systems.
description: A low-level, unstyled React component library focused on accessibility, customization and developer experience: accordion, alert dialog, avatar, checkbox, dialog, dropdown menu, form, menubar, navigation menu, one-time password field, popover, progress, select, slider, switch, tabs, toast, toolbar and tooltip, plus utilities like portal and slot. Use them as the base layer of a design system or adopt them incrementally; the docs cover styling, animation, composition and server-side rendering.
contains: around 30 unstyled, accessible primitives plus utilities
use as a design-system base layer or adopt incrementally
docs guides: styling, animation, composition, server-side rendering
